D/ CONSTANS PF AVG ; R/ *VICTORAE AVGG* in ex (A?)SIS

Copper alloy nummus of Consatns Diameter 16mm, thickness 1mm, weight 1.82g Date 343-348AD Obverse: Laureate, darped & cuirassed bust facing right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANS PF AVG Reverse: Victory walking left, with a chi-ro to the left. Reverse inscription. *VICTORAE AVGG* in ex (A?)SIS Mint: SISCIA (Croatia) Condition: Very fine
